claim: Digital Summit 2026 is the cross-border digital conference held 24 March 2026, 13:30, at Vaduzer-Saal in Vaduz; ninth edition.
quote: Der Digital Summit, die länderübergreifende Konferenz für Digitalisierung und Innovation, geht am 24. März 2026 ab 13:30 Uhr im Vaduzer-Saal in Vaduz in die nächste Runde.

claim: Digital Summit 2026 theme is 'Global Technology Meets European Sovereignty' with 450+ decision-makers; speakers include NVIDIA, ETH Zurich, Palantir.
quote: Mehr als 450 Entscheidungsträgerinnen und Entscheidungsträger aus Wirtschaft, Wissenschaft und Politik diskutierten aktuelle Entwicklungen rund um Künstliche Intelligenz und digitale Transformation.

claim: Cyber Security Workshop on 3 March 2026 at Technopark Liechtenstein, Vaduz, organised by digital-liechtenstein.li with sl.one, ensec AG and the Office for Cyber Security; ~40 SME and enterprise attendees.
quote: Am 3. März 2026 lud die Standortinitiative digital-liechtenstein.li gemeinsam mit den Mitgliedsunternehmen sl.one und ensec AG sowie dem Amt für Cybersicherheit zum Cyber Security Workshop in den Technopark Liechtenstein.

claim: KI-Meetup Graubünden Nr. 6 took place Wednesday 18 February 2026, 17:00–19:00, at ibW Höhere Fachschule Südostschweiz in Chur; free, registration required.
quote: Wednesday, 18 February 2026, 17:00 to 19:00. ibW Höhere Fachschule Südostschweiz, Chur.

claim: KI-Meetup Graubünden Nr. 7 held 20 May 2026 at FHGR Service Innovation Lab (Pulvermühlestrasse 57, 7000 Chur), keynote 'AI Beyond the Hype' by Süsstrunk & Weichselbraun; organised by Markenkern AG with GRdigital and Code Crush.
quote: Fachhochschule Graubünden, Service Innovation Lab (SIL), Pulvermühlestrasse 57, 7000 Chur. Wednesday, May 20, 2026 | 17:00–19:00.

claim: Digitaltag Vaduz 2026 runs Friday 20 November 2026, 17:00–22:00, at Kunstmuseum Vaduz; theme is the influence of digitalisation and AI on daily life.
quote: Der Digitaltag Vaduz bietet eine besondere Gelegenheit, den digitalen Wandel hautnah zu erleben und neue Technologien zu entdecken. Im Mittelpunkt steht dieses Jahr der Einfluss von Digitalisierung und KI auf uns.

claim: OCLA 2026 symposium ran 26 March 2026, 09:00–19:00, in Buchs SG; focused on optical coatings, laser technology and LIDT measurement; organised by RhySearch.
quote: OCLA 2026, March 26, 2026, 09:00–19:00, Buchs SG, Switzerland. Geared towards technically interested engineers and scientists working with laser optics, high-end optical thin film deposition and characterisation.

quote: Infotag - October 29 & 31, 2026 - FH Graubünden, Chur. Multiple technology-focused degrees including Artificial Intelligence in Software Engineering, Engineering, Mobile Robotics, Computational and Data Science.

claim: Technopark Liechtenstein at Schaanerstrasse 27, Vaduz, hosts a year-round programme of startup lectures, workshops, pitches and discussion rounds covering pitching, growth hacking, agile development and exit strategy.
quote: Technopark Liechtenstein offers a mix of lectures, workshops, pitches and discussion rounds, with topics ranging from pitching and growth hacking to agile development and exit strategy selection.
